name: Devon Energy
description: Devon is a US-only independent oil, natural gas and NGL producer; its largest and most active program is the Delaware Basin (New Mexico and west Texas), followed by the Williston Basin, Rockies, Eagle Ford and Anadarko Basin. It sells production at market prices and also runs a marketing and midstream operation that buys and resells third-party commodities, which is why a third of revenue is not its own production. On May 7, 2026 it completed an all-stock merger of equals with Coterra Energy (each Coterra share converted into 0.70 Devon share), so FY2025 figures below are Devon alone before that deal.

businessLines.name: Oil, gas and NGL sales (own production)
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, natural gas and NGLs it produces at market-based prices at the wellhead or downstream delivery points; no contracted margin.

businessLines.name: Marketing and midstream revenues
businessLines.how: Buys third-party oil, gas and NGLs and resells them, earning a spread, plus fees for midstream services.

businessLines.name: Oil, gas and NGL derivatives
businessLines.how: Gains and losses on commodity hedges recorded in revenue.

brands.name: Coterra Energy
brands.note: Merger of equals completed 2026-05-07; Coterra holders received 0.70 Devon share per Coterra share. Adds Marcellus Shale (Pennsylvania), more Delaware Basin and Anadarko Basin assets.
